t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each round there will be two coloured mushrooms and one will give more mushrooms than the other so pay attention to see the patterns. As the rounds progress, the higher mushroom gnomes may change and now become lower mushroom gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: You will be shown two coloured gnomes and take note of the pattern of how many mushrooms each gnome gives you as a different colour will equal more mushrooms. Pay attention though as the colours may change so what was a high mushroom giving gnome may become lower.
